spec_match.rationale: Builds the spec's own recipe (@media (any-pointer: coarse) a::interest-button { content: "ⓘ" / "" }) and variations into a live stylesheet.

interactive.rationale: Glyph, alt text, when, tap-target, fill and scope controls rewrite the injected rule; measured box width and status update on every change.

blurb_alignment.rationale: All promised controls and readouts present.

edge_cases.rationale: 'never' (UA default) and false coarse media query both measured as 0px, asserted; ::after ordering shown on the Babbage link.

references.rationale: Links ChromeStatus and the spec section.

conformance.rationale: Exercises the opt-in (UA content none) and styleability contracts of the feature suite.

runtime_evidence.rationale: Headless Chromium 153.0.8010.12 (Playwright) at 1280x800 and 360x740 DPR3 touch, both without the flag and with --enable-blink-features=HTMLInterestForInterestButtonPseudo; console and network clean, 0px horizontal overflow on every run. Flag on: 'always' gave 46.6px (44px min + margin), 'Preview' filled with buttons 71.4px, tap-target off 78.5px (padding instead of min size), 'never' 0px. Mobile coarse pointer rendered by default. Found and fixed a wrapped-link measurement bug (119px) by summing line fragments; screenshot reviewed.

telemetry_health.rationale: Gated-off branch asserts box===0; rendered branch asserts >=43.5px when the 44px option is on; fallback asserts the status does not claim rendering.

design_system.rationale: Generated rules use var(--accent-blue)/var(--bg-ivory) tokens only.

accessibility.rationale: Fieldsets with legends, 44px labels, live status; the glyph is marked decorative with / "".

mobile_desktop_parity.rationale: Desktop shows the media-query-false explanation by default; mobile renders natively; both verified.

openQuestions.title: Real-device coarse-pointer check
openQuestions.detail: Emulated touch reports any-pointer: coarse; confirm on a hybrid laptop with touch screen where any-pointer is coarse but pointer is fine.

guidanceConsulted.query: accessible CSS generated content alt text decorative glyph
guidanceConsulted.recommendation: Use content: "x" / "" for purely decorative generated text; never carry meaning only in generated content.
guidanceConsulted.appliedOrException: Every ::interest-button rule uses content: "ⓘ" / ""; the meaning stays on the link and its hint.

guidanceConsulted.query: responsive control panel without horizontal overflow
guidanceConsulted.recommendation: Grids collapse to one column on narrow viewports, long tokens wrap, tap targets >= 44px.
guidanceConsulted.appliedOrException: Single-column grids below 720px, overflow-wrap:anywhere on code/readouts, 44px labels/buttons; measured 0px overflow at 360px.

guidanceConsulted.query: responsive control panel without horizontal overflow
guidanceConsulted.recommendation: Keep touch targets usable across devices and adapt affordances to input type.
guidanceConsulted.appliedOrException: Offers any-pointer: coarse gating plus a 44px min-size toggle so the trade-off is visible.

summary: Live rule builder for the opt-in pseudo-element with measured output and honest no-box states.
